topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I just found out that Alex, someone I've only ever talked to online, lives right here in the same city. I’m not sure how I feel about that. We’ve been chatting for months, and I always felt safe because we were far apart. Now, I keep thinking about the things they’ve shared, how personal they got. Suddenly, the distance that felt protective is gone. I’m not sure if I should even reach out or if it’s better to just stay quiet and see if they say something first. Meeting in person feels too big, too fast. I need some time to think about this.
